card.name: Ending of the word parenteral
card.fires_on: The piece "eral" completing the word "parenteral", right after "parent". It appears in parenteral nutrition, parenteral doses and parenteral penicillin.

modes.label: Parenteral nutrition
modes.description: "eral" ends "parent" before the word nutrition, in liver disease and calcium warnings.
modes.example: patients who receive parent<<eral>> nutrition for extended periods of time, especially

modes.label: Parenteral drug or dose
modes.description: "eral" ends "parent" before doses or a named injectable drug.

card.plain: It marks the end of the word "parenteral" (given by injection or infusion), mostly in parenteral nutrition text.
